fixes.explanation: Wisdom is a very Proverbs kind of word, so I see the pull. But her line says, "Open your mouth for those with no voice…" (Proverbs 31:8) Picture someone on mute in a meeting, talking away, and nobody can hear a word. She's telling the king to be the one who speaks up for them. I think that's a big job for one mouth.

It's actually true. The verse says, "Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed." (Proverbs 31:8) Look at that little word "all" in there, because she doesn't say some of the dispossessed. So the card matches her words exactly, and that king's mouth has plenty of work ahead of it.

Right, it's false. Her last line is, "Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy." (Proverbs 31:9) She puts the king's mouth and his judging to work together, and both of them go to the poor and needy. I think this mother ended her whole talk with a mic drop.
